command_line:
set -eu
cat > alpha_compare.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_file <- args[1]
metadata_file <- args[2]
out_file <- args[3]
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
counts_df <- read.table(counts_file, header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
genes <- counts_df[[1]]
mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1, drop=FALSE]); rownames(mat) <- genes; storage.mode(mat) <- "integer"
meta <- read.delim(metadata_file, header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, fill=TRUE, quote="")
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$sample) & meta$sample != "", c("sample","condition","sex"), drop=FALSE]
meta <- meta[meta$condition %in% c("ASXL1","Control") & meta$sex %in% c("M","F"), , drop=FALSE]
matched <- meta$sample[meta$sample %in% colnames(mat)]
meta <- meta[match(matched, meta$sample), , drop=FALSE]
mat <- mat[, meta$sample, drop=FALSE]
meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels=c("Control","ASXL1")); meta$sex <- factor(meta$sex); rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=mat, colData=meta, design=~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res05 <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition","ASXL1","Control"), alpha=0.05)
res10 <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition","ASXL1","Control"), alpha=0.10)
lines <- c(paste("alpha_0.05", sum(!is.na(res05$padj) & res05$padj < 0.05), sep="\t"), paste("alpha_0.10", sum(!is.na(res10$padj) & res10$padj < 0.05), sep="\t"), paste("na_padj_alpha_0.05", sum(is.na(res05$padj)), sep="\t"), paste("na_padj_alpha_0.10", sum(is.na(res10$padj)), sep="\t"))
writeLines(lines, out_file)
RSCRIPT
